tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the measured datasets on agentexchange.work/data (Claude Code cost anatomy, tokens per day, plugin marketplace star sample, MCP registry census, npm MCP-server download sample, Show HN outcomes, issue gap maps, token-reduction tools) with pull dates.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Return one dataset as JSON. Names: cost-anatomy, tokens-per-day, plugins-marketplace, mcp-registry, npm-mcp-servers, show-hn-claude-code, issues-gap-map, token-reduction-tools.

tools.name: issue_gap_map
tools.description: Top open issues by thumbs-up for anthropics/claude-code, openai/codex or google-gemini/gemini-cli: what users ask for loudest that is still open.

tools.name: show_hn_claude_code_stats
tools.description: Points distribution of every Show HN launch with 'Claude Code' in the title over the last 90 days (count, median, p75, p90, share reaching 50 points, top posts).

tools.name: mcp_registry_census
tools.description: Full-crawl census of the official MCP registry: unique servers, new servers per day, remote share, share of remote servers with no auth.

tools.name: score_idea
tools.description: Score a product idea against LIVE market data: the idea in plain words is turned into a market lookup, comparables are pulled from the directory where it would ship (npm, VS Code, WordPress.org, GitHub, Hacker News, Apify, Hugging Face, MCP registry), newcomers (<=24 months) set the reach, sourced p

tools.name: github_trending
tools.description: GitHub Trending (which has no official API or history): today's list, this week, this month, or a language's daily list; or a past day's snapshot by date. Scraped daily and archived.

tools.name: claude_code_cost_anatomy
tools.description: Measured anatomy of 160 real Claude Code sessions: cache-read share of billed context, oversized tool-output share, and the replay effect of capping tool results at 8,000 characters.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_dataset, issue_gap_map · Private data: list_datasets, get_dataset · Public sink: show_hn_claude_code_stats, mcp_registry_census, claude_code_cost_anatomy · Destructive: score_idea.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_dataset, issue_gap_map · Private data: list_datasets, get_dataset · Public sink: show_hn_claude_code_stats, mcp_registry_census, claude_code_cost_anatomy · Destructive: score_idea

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
